title: Manager | SAP CPI | Noida | SAP | DSA Emerging
description:
**Manager | SAP CPI | Noida | SAP | DSA Emerging**
  
• **Job requisition ID** : 110189
  
• **Location**: Noida
  
• **Entity**: Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu India LLP

**The team**

Enterprise technology must do much more than keep the wheels turning; it is the engine that drives functional excellence and the enabler of innovation and long-term growth. Learn more about ET&P

**Your work profile**

* Lead enterprise integration architecture, design, and delivery initiatives across SAP and non-SAP landscapes using SAP Integration Suite.
* Define and govern integration strategies, architecture standards, API frameworks, and best practices to support digital transformation programs.
* Design scalable, secure, and resilient integration solutions leveraging SAP Integration Suite components including Cloud Integration (CPI), API Management, and Event Mesh.
* Develop and govern enterprise integration artifacts including canonical data models, interface catalogs, integration patterns, mapping specifications, sequence diagrams, message flows, and error-handling frameworks.
* Lead the design and implementation of API-led integration architectures supporting hybrid and cloud-based application landscapes.
* Oversee the development and deployment of CPI iFlows, message mappings, value mappings, routing logic, transformation rules, and integration monitoring solutions.
* Design and implement event-driven integration architectures using SAP Event Mesh and asynchronous communication frameworks.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, solution architects, functional teams, and technical teams to define integration requirements and solution roadmaps.
* Ensure seamless integration between SAP S/4HANA, SAP SuccessFactors, SAP Ariba, SAP BTP, third-party applications, cloud platforms, and enterprise systems.
* Establish integration governance processes covering security, performance, monitoring, logging, exception management, and operational support.
* Lead troubleshooting and resolution of complex integration issues across enterprise environments.
* Drive adoption of enterprise integration patterns, reusable services, integration accelerators, and API governance frameworks.
* Mentor integration consultants and developers while driving technical excellence and capability development within the team.
* Support pre-sales activities, client proposals, solution estimations, architecture reviews, and digital transformation initiatives.

**Key Requirements**

* 10+ years of experience in enterprise integration technologies with at least 5+ years of hands-on experience in SAP Integration Suite.
* Proven experience leading integration architecture and delivery teams across large-scale transformation programs.
* Strong expertise in SAP Integration Suite, including Cloud Integration (CPI), API Management, and Event Mesh.
* Deep understanding of API-led integration architectures, enterprise integration patterns, service-oriented architecture, and microservices-based integration approaches.
* Extensive experience designing and implementing CPI iFlows, message mappings, routing mechanisms, transformation logic, integration adapters, and monitoring solutions.
* Strong expertise in REST, SOAP, OData, IDoc, XML, JSON, Web Services, and API integration technologies.
* Hands-on experience with message and value mappings, error handling frameworks, exception management, and operational support models.
* Experience designing canonical data models, interface catalogs, integration governance frameworks, and enterprise integration standards.
* Strong understanding of event-driven architecture and asynchronous integration concepts using SAP Event Mesh.
* Experience with SAP Cloud ALM, integration monitoring, alerting, logging, and operational governance.
* Strong knowledge of SAP S/4HANA integration, SAP BTP services, SAP Ariba, SuccessFactors, Concur, and third-party application integrations.
* Experience with Groovy scripting and custom integration development within SAP Integration Suite.
* Strong stakeholder management, solution architecture, communication, and leadership capabilities.
* Ability to drive architectural decisions, governance reviews, technical discussions, and enterprise-wide integration strategies.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* SAP Integration Suite, SAP BTP, SAP CPI, or SAP Certified Development Associate certifications are preferred.
* Certifications in Enterprise Architecture, Cloud Integration, API Management, TOGAF, or related technologies will be an added advantage.
* Exposure to SAP Activate, Agile, DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and enterprise cloud transformation programs is highly desirable.
* Experience working in global delivery models, multinational environments, and large-scale SAP transformation initiatives is preferred.
* Strong consulting, leadership, stakeholder management, and solution governance experience will be an added advantage.

title: Presales Executive
description:
**Company:** Innov Arch

**Position:** Pre-Sales Executive / Telecalling Specialist

**Experience Required:** 0 to 1 Year (Freshers are welcome)

**Salary:** ₹15,000 – ₹25,000 per month + Attractive Incentives

**Location:** Noida uttar pradesh

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**About Innov Arch**

At **Innov Arch**, we specialize in providing innovative, high-quality architectural and interior design solutions. From premium residential homes to corporate office spaces, we help clients bring their spatial visions to life.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an energetic and articulate **Pre-Sales Executive** to join our growth team. In this role, you will be the first point of contact for potential clients interested in architectural and interior design services. Your primary responsibility will be contacting inbound leads, understanding client requirements, explaining our core offerings, and scheduling meetings for our senior design team.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Lead Qualification & Outreach:**
* Connect with prospective clients via phone calls, WhatsApp, and email to qualify incoming inquiries.
* Understand initial client requirements (project type, space area, budget, timeline, and design expectations).
* **Consultation & Pitching:**
* Introduce **Innov Arch’s** portfolio, architectural services, interior packages, and design process clearly to potential clients.
* Answer preliminary queries regarding project timelines, estimation procedures, and site visit schedules.
* **Appointment Setting & Pipeline Management:**
* Schedule in-office meetings, virtual consultations, or site visits for Senior Architects and Interior Designers.
* Maintain and regularly update client details, call status, and follow-up notes in the company CRM/Excel.
* **Follow-up & Nurturing:**
* Consistently follow up with warm leads to encourage decision-making and maintain strong client engagement.
* Coordinate with the sales and design teams to ensure smooth handoff of qualified client leads.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* **Education:** Graduate in any discipline (BBA, B.Com, BA, B.Sc, or Diploma in Sales/Marketing/Design preferred).
* **Experience:** 0 to 1 year of experience in pre-sales, telecalling, customer support, or client handling. *(Freshers with excellent communication skills are strongly encouraged to apply).*
* **Key Skills:**
* **Communication:** Excellent verbal and written communication in English and Hindi.
* **Interpersonal Skills:** Confident, persuasive, polite, and customer-centric mindset.
* **Technical Basic:** Proficient in MS Excel / Google Sheets, phone handling, and basic CRM software usage.
* **Interest:** A genuine interest in architecture, home interiors, and real estate development is a major plus.

**What We Offer**

* **Competitive Pay:** ₹15,000 – ₹25,000 per month fixed salary.
* **Incentives:** Performance-linked monthly incentives on converted client leads.
* **Growth:** Continuous training, mentorship from senior design leads, and career advancement opportunities into full Sales/Client Management roles.
* **Culture:** Friendly, supportive, and professional work environment

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: ELV Design Manager
description:
**Roles \& Responsibilities**

The Lead Engineer is responsible for leading the engineering and design of ELV systems throughout all project phases. The role includes technical leadership, multidisciplinary coordination, quality assurance, client interaction, and mentoring engineers to deliver projects on schedule, within budget, and in compliance with applicable codes and standards.

* Lead the design and engineering of ELV systems, including:
* Fire Detection \& Alarm System (FAS)
* Public Address \& Voice Alarm (PAVA)
* CCTV Surveillance
* Access Control System (ACS)
* Intrusion Detection System (IDS)
* Structured Cabling System (SCS)
* ICT \& Telecom Networks
* Building Management System (BMS)
* Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS)
* Physical Security Information Management (PSIM)
* Integrated Security Management Systems (ISMS)
* Develop design concepts, system architecture, basis of design reports, design calculations, and technical specifications.
* Prepare equipment sizing, BOQs, cable schedules, IO schedules, network architecture, and technical documentation.
* Ensure compliance with client requirements and applicable international and local codes and standards.

Preferred Project Experience : 8\-12 years

* Hyperscale Data Centers
* Colocation Data Centers
* Semiconductor Manufacturing Facilities
* Airports
* Hospitals
* Commercial Buildings
* Smart Buildings
* Industrial Manufacturing Facilities
* Government and Critical Infrastructure Projects

Pay: ₹100,000\.00 \- ₹115,000\.00 per year
